summary.text: On May 27, 2026, Jefferson expressed optimism about AI's potential to drive productivity and growth while monitoring its effects on employment and inflation. In November 2025, he recognized AI-related job displacement as a real risk and said job losses were likely for some firms and workers. He also urged humility in predicting AI's employment and inflation effects and encouraged policymakers, businesses, and individuals to remain adaptable.

statements.text: I have already mentioned one challenge, which is to make sure we are acquiring the right "alternative" data, making the right inferences, and appropriately using tools such as artificial intelligence, including machine learning, to analyze this wealth of data.
